# Cursor team settings checklist

Cursor applies these from the team admin dashboard (Teams / Enterprise). SessionFS cannot set them, so it lists every field as checked by SessionFS only.

- [ ] Dashboard > Plugins & MCPs: import the team marketplace `https://api.sessionfs.dev/catalogs/acme`.
- [ ] Dashboard > Plugins & MCPs: keep only SessionFS catalogs as team marketplaces.
- [ ] Dashboard > MCP Configuration (Enterprise): allowlist only approved servers (local servers: none; remote servers: origins `https://mcp.acme.com/*`).
